description: This file defines the MonkeyTouchEvent class, a subclass of MonkeyMotionEvent, representing touch events in the Android Monkey testing tool. It specifies a constructor for creating touch event instances and overrides a method to label the event type.

classes.name: MonkeyTouchEvent
classes.description: Represents a touch event within the Android Monkey testing framework, subclassing MonkeyMotionEvent to specify touch-specific behavior.

methods.name: MonkeyTouchEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a touch event with a specific action type, setting the event type and input source.

methods.name: getTypeLabel
methods.description: Overrides the method to return the label 'Touch' for this event type.
